1. Medium: [`summarize_test.go:742`](/Users/alisha/.superset/worktrees/cli/agent-improvements/cmd/entire/cli/summarize/summarize_test.go#L742) `TestGenerateFromTranscript_NilGenerator` is still nondeterministic and can cross the unit-test boundary into the real `claude` CLI. On a machine where `claude` is installed and authenticated, this test can make a real external call, consume tokens, and still “pass” without asserting any concrete behavior. This should be replaced with a stubbed default-generator seam or an explicit fake, not a best-effort “should not panic” check.

2. Medium: [`summarize_test.go:684`](/Users/alisha/.superset/worktrees/cli/agent-improvements/cmd/entire/cli/summarize/summarize_test.go#L684) and [`summarize_test.go:707`](/Users/alisha/.superset/worktrees/cli/agent-improvements/cmd/entire/cli/summarize/summarize_test.go#L707) improved the explicit/implicit insight coverage, but each test still validates only one explanatory bucket. Both mocked responses populate `implementation_rationale`, `tradeoffs`, and `codebase_patterns`; a regression affecting the unasserted fields under these prompt modes would still slip through.

3. Low: Most tests in [`claude_test.go:61`](/Users/alisha/.superset/worktrees/cli/agent-improvements/cmd/entire/cli/summarize/claude_test.go#L61), [`claude_test.go:103`](/Users/alisha/.superset/worktrees/cli/agent-improvements/cmd/entire/cli/summarize/claude_test.go#L103), [`summarize_test.go:17`](/Users/alisha/.superset/worktrees/cli/agent-improvements/cmd/entire/cli/summarize/summarize_test.go#L17), and [`summarize_test.go:653`](/Users/alisha/.superset/worktrees/cli/agent-improvements/cmd/entire/cli/summarize/summarize_test.go#L653) omit `t.Parallel()` despite the repo convention. That is mostly a test-maintainability issue, but it also reduces the chance of catching hidden shared-state assumptions early. The `t.Setenv` case should stay serial; most of the rest appear parallel-safe.

`go test ./cmd/entire/cli/summarize` passes on the current local tree.
